baselineSource.note: Baselines are copied from the exact-head responsive/accessibility evidence produced after Wave 1 shell + Wave 2 Home + Wave 3 responsive integration. They are review-only assets and are never auto-updated by CI.

requirements.assertion: computed background is light and height is exactly 64px

requirements.requirement: Sidebar clara com agrupamentos e largura canônica.
Contexto Global/Destino sempre visível, com busca, notificações e perfil.
requirements.assertion: all topbar context controls visible; destination width >= 90px

requirements.requirement: KPIs: Empresas, Afiliados, Reservas Hoje, Receita Hoje, Alertas.
requirements.assertion: exactly five KPI cards and canonical order

requirements.requirement: Attention Queue imediatamente abaixo dos KPIs e sem estreitamento indevido.
requirements.assertion: primary block order + width >= 72% of Home content

requirements.requirement: Sem dashboard técnico dominando a Home; SHA/readiness fora da hierarquia principal.
requirements.assertion: technical meta hidden + no dark dominant body background
Attention labels keep usable horizontal geometry
heading -> KPIs -> attention -> destination summary -> lower grid top positions monotonic

requirements.requirement: Drawer tablet/mobile acessível e ausente no desktop.
requirements.assertion: trigger visibility by breakpoint + aria-expanded + Escape close
deterministic empty API fixture renders explicit empty/unavailable semantics
